title: ui-preview: compose PreviewPhase component
description: Compose the PreviewPhase component that integrates the summary display and Four Brutal Truths checklist. Provides a cohesive review experience where users can examine extracted artifacts and validate quality gates before proceeding to compilation.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL render preview phase with summary and checklist components
THE SYSTEM SHALL coordinate validation state between subcomponents

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL display summary and Four Brutal Truths checklist side by side

event_driven.trigger: WHEN all brutal truths are validated and user clicks proceed
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL transition to Kirk compilation phase

unwanted.condition: IF user attempts to bypass validation
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow transition without complete validation
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT display outdated artifact information
unwanted.because: Users must review current extraction results

preconditions: Summary display component must be ready
Four Brutal Truths checklist must be initialized
Phase transition handler must be defined
postconditions: Preview phase shows complete review interface
Users can review all artifacts before proceeding
Validation gates are enforced before transition
invariants: Proceed action state reflects validation status

happy: Given preview phase is active, when component renders, then summary and checklist are both visible
Given all truths validated, when user clicks proceed, then phase transitions to Kirk compilation
Given user clicks back, when navigation occurs, then phase returns to extracting
error: Given incomplete validation, when user clicks proceed, then error message shows missing validations
Given summary fails to load, when preview renders, then fallback message is displayed
Given phase transition fails, when error occurs, then user remains in preview with error feedback
